>Experience the Hikvision DS-D5B75RB/EL 75-Inch 4K UHD Interactive Display at TBZ Engineering

Transform your classrooms, conference rooms, and professional environments with the

>Hikvision DS-D5B75RB/EL 75-Inch 4K UHD Interactive Display. This cutting-edge interactive flat panel delivers stunning visuals with a 4K UHD resolution of 3840 × 2160, a VA panel, 400 cd/m² brightness, and a 72% NTSC color gamut for vibrant, lifelike images. Its anti-glare 3.2 mm tempered glass with 9H surface hardness ensures durability and clear visibility, boasting a 50,000-hour lifespan. With 178° viewing angles and a 16:9 aspect ratio, this 4K display is perfect for collaborative settings.

>Unmatched Performance and Interactivity

Powered by a Cortex-A55 quad-core processor (1.92 GHz) and a Mali-G52 MP2 GPU, the Hikvision Interactive Display runs on Android 13.0, offering 8GB RAM and 128GB storage for seamless multitasking. The 40-point infrared multi-touch technology delivers precise responses in less than 5ms, making it ideal for interactive whiteboarding, presentations, and teaching. The 32767 × 32767 touch resolution ensures pinpoint accuracy, enhancing user engagement.

>interactive flat panel features dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4GHz/5GHz), Bluetooth 5.2, and NFC for effortless wireless connectivity. It includes two HDMI 2.0 inputs, USB 3.0, USB 2.0, Type-C, and LAN ports for versatile device integration. The built-in 2 × 20W speakers provide rich audio across a 200–20kHz frequency range, while a light sensor adjusts brightness for optimal viewing. With OPS/OPS-C compatibility and optional Windows support, this 4K display adapts to diverse workflows.

>Hikvision DS-D5B75RB/EL offers dynamic (30,000:1) and static (5,000:1) contrast ratios for deep blacks and vivid details. Its front-facing multi-button controls simplify operation, making it a top choice for educational and corporate settings. The sleek, durable design and intelligent temperature control ensure reliability and environmental friendliness.
